hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,sys,pathlib,re; raw=sys.stdin.read() or "{}"; data=json.loads(raw); tn=data.get("tool_name") or ""; ti=data.get("tool_input") or {}; cmd=(ti.get("command","") or ""); m=re.search(r"([\w/.-]+(?:_MASTER|master|-master)\.xlsx)", cmd) if tn=="Bash" else None; bash_target=pathlib.Path(m.group(1)) if m else None; bash_sidecar=(bash_target.parent/("~$"+bash_target.name)) if bash_target else None; bash_blocked=bool(bash_sidecar and bash_sidecar.exists()); tgt=ti.get("file_path") or ti.get("path") or ""; n=os.path.basename(tgt); is_master=bool(tgt) and (n.endswith("_MASTER.xlsx") or n=="master.xlsx" or n.endswith("-master.xlsx")); p=pathlib.Path(tgt) if is_master else None; sidecar=(p.parent/("~$"+p.name)) if p else None; ew_blocked=bool(sidecar and sidecar.exists()); sc=bash_sidecar if bash_blocked else (sidecar if ew_blocked else None); blocked=bool(sc); sys.stderr.write("BLOCKED: Excel/LibreOffice owner-lock present at "+str(sc)+chr(10)) if blocked else None; sys.exit(2 if blocked else 0)'
